title: Two deer killed by suspected poachers in Rajasthan's Barmer; villagers stage protest

ai.summary: Villagers in Rajasthan's Barmer district staged a sit-in protest demanding the arrest of suspected poachers who allegedly killed two deer and tied one carcass before hanging it upside down.

facts.claim: Two deer killed by suspected poachers in Rajasthan's Barmer
facts.quote: Two deer were allegedly killed by poachers in Rajasthan's Barmer district, triggering protests by villagers demanding the immediate arrest of those responsible, officials said.
Following the incident, villagers gathered and began a sit-in protest, demanding the arrest of the accused and stronger measures to protect wildlife.
